statement: Pinned SDL Wii HIDAPI identifies a present or mapped MotionPlus by two-byte extension identity reads at A400FE and A600FE and a masked suffix predicate; this does not compare a complete built-in A4200005 against external A6200005 or identify an early 0306 hardware revision. On Linux its MotionPlus activation writer is intentionally suppressed in favor of kernel ownership. A 0306 identity alone therefore cannot establish native SDL gyro availability; sensor registration and kernel mapping remain conditional.

applicability.revision: SDL pinned Wii HIDAPI with early 0306 candidate; source only, no SDL early-unit run
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. SDL 3.2.10 hidapi Wii 385-427,457-491,677-820; PID support in pinned SDL IDs. No host test.
